title: ATS Job Board Aggregator
description: Fetches open roles directly from companies' applicant tracking systems (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workable, Recruitee) and returns them in one normalized shape. Uses each ATS's public no-auth JSON API, so there is no scraping, no rate-limit pain, and nothing to block. Filter by title keywords, remote status, and location. Boards are given as 'ats:account', e.g. 'greenhouse:stripe' or 'lever:leverdemo' — the account is the slug in the company's job board URL.

boards.description: Boards to fetch, each as 'ats:account'. Valid ats values: greenhouse, lever, ashby, smartrecruiters, workable, recruitee. Example: ["greenhouse:stripe", "ashby:ramp"].

titleIncludes.description: Keep only roles whose title contains at least one of these (case-insensitive). Example: ["marketing", "growth", "performance"].

remoteOnly.description: Keep only roles the ATS marks remote, or whose location mentions remote.

locationIncludes.description: Keep only roles whose location contains one of these (case-insensitive).

includeDescription.description: Include the job description. Off by default because descriptions are long and most searches only need titles and links. Note: for Greenhouse boards this flag also controls whether the `department` field is populated, because both come from the same underlying request.

maxDescriptionChars.description: Truncate each description to this length.

maxPerBoard.description: Cap results taken from any single board, applied after filtering.

eligibleFrom.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code of the candidate, e.g. "IN" for India. When set, roles whose location is limited to other countries or regions are dropped, and each result gains `eligibility` (open/restricted/unknown) with a reason. Use this when "remote" is not enough — a "Remote U.S." role is remote and still closed to someone without US work authorisation.

includeUnknownEligibility.description: Keep roles whose location gives no region at all (a bare "Remote"). On by default: these are the largest group and any restriction is usually buried in the description, so dropping them hides real opportunities. Set false for a stricter, shorter list.
